title: Rudolph Left Me a Present!
about: A child decides Rudolph deserves a Christmas snack and concludes the reindeer returned the favor.
description: Why does Santa get all the cookies when the reindeer do the hard work? Told from a child's wonderfully serious perspective, this playful Christmas song follows a young narrator who decides Rudolph deserves his own snack. When a present appears under the tree, there is only one logical explanation: Rudolph must have left it as a thank-you. The grown-ups may give Santa the credit, but the narrator has already settled the matter and plans to leave more treats next year.
lyrics: I came running to the living room,
Saw the cookies sitting out for Santa,
Santa gets the milk and cookies,
While his reindeer pull the sleigh?
He deserves a snack, I'd say!
So I grabbed a little something,
And I put it by the tree,
'Cause if Santa gets a thank-you snack,
I know it! Yes, he did!
And he left a gift for me!
That's just how the reindeer business works,
But Rudolph's got his own ideas,
I don't know how he wrapped it,
With those hooves upon his feet,
But if he can fly across the sky,
I know it! Yes, he did!
And he left a gift for me!
That's just how the reindeer business works,
"And don't tell me Santa brought it!"
And he's not that big or tall!
He's got antlers and a shiny nose,
And if you give that deer a snack,
I gave that deer a little snack,
But this one's just for me!
